extracted.name: Maroulosalata (Greek Romaine Salad)
extracted.description: Maroulosalata is a Greek green salad made with sliced romaine, dill, olive oil, and red wine vinegar for a deliciously light salad full of flavor.
ingredient_lines: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Wash and dry romaine lettuce. Lay leaves on a cutting board and slice lengthwise across the leaves, shredding them into 1/4-inch strips.
Transfer lettuce to a large bowl. Add scallions, dill, olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; toss until well combined. Adjust oil, vinegar, and seasoning to taste.
